title: Waiting on Kestrel
text: Still nothing from the Kestrel grant committee. Six weeks since I submitted and the only word was an automated receipt. Refreshing my inbox like that will change anything.
summary: You are waiting on a funding decision and the silence is wearing on you.

title: Flashcard Slog
text: Ninety minutes of Dutch flashcards tonight. Nouns are fine, separable verbs are not. I keep freezing on anything with a split prefix.
summary: You are grinding through exam prep and struggling with verb forms.

title: Pool Before Class
text: Up at six, swam a mile before class for the fourth day straight. Shoulders are wrecked but I got the outline finished after.
summary: You kept your morning routine and made progress on your writing.

title: Bouldering With Ines and Rui
text: Climbed with Ines and Rui for two hours, then we got noodles after. First time in a while I did not think about the grant at all.
summary: You spent the evening with friends climbing and eating.

title: Running Out of Steam
text: Third weekend in a row at the desk. I cannot make myself care about this chapter anymore and I do not know if that is the chapter or me.
summary: You are exhausted and losing motivation for your work.
openLoops: decide whether to restructure the chapter

title: Wrong Index
text: Four hours chasing a slow query before Nadia pointed out the index was on the wrong column the whole time. Embarrassing but she was kind about it.
summary: You lost a day to a problem a colleague spotted immediately.

title: Called Gran
text: Called Gran for the first time in a few weeks. She sounded tired but did not want to talk about it. I should visit.
summary: You checked in with your grandmother and sensed something was off.

title: Chess Rating
text: Broke sixteen hundred rapid tonight. Probably should have been reading but it felt good to be good at something.
summary: You enjoyed a small milestone as a break from pressure.

title: Climbing Club Committee
text: Elections are next week and I said I would run the beginner sessions. Not sure what I signed up for but the others seem glad.
summary: You took on a role organising sessions for the club.

title: Rereading January
text: Went back through my notebooks from January. I was so much more optimistic then. Not sure whether that is sad or just information.
summary: You reflected on how your outlook has shifted since the start of the year.

title: Talk Went Fine
text: The talk went fine. Nobody asked the question I was dreading and the figures held up under scrutiny.
summary: A presentation you were nervous about went smoothly.

title: Could Not Sleep
text: Lay awake turning over the conversation with Theo about who owns the dataset. I never followed up and it is going to come back around.
summary: An unresolved conversation kept you up.
openLoops: follow up with Theo about the dataset
